note: Gold set for the parse pipeline's dev metric. Every row was read off the scan by a person (docs/manuals.md, 2026-09-16), not invented. Rows marked provenance=us_manual come from the English release's text and are tagged so the Japanese parse is not scored against them by accident. Page numbers in this file are PRINTED pages; PDF pages from pdftoppm/tesseract are printed+1 (cover pages).

facts.quote_hint: 3D画面では前方にのみ攻撃発砲します

statement_keys.eight-directions: The gun fires in eight directions, including left and up-left 45°.
statement_keys.fire-left: Firing left is a printed control.
statement_keys.3d-forward-only: On 3D screens the gun points forward only; UP advances, LEFT/RIGHT strafe, DOWN goes prone.
statement_keys.scroll-modes: Scroll is vertical, horizontal or 3D by area; underwater is a further mode.
statement_keys.sensor-advance: Destroying the zone's detection sensor is the advance condition.
statement_keys.extra-life: A cleared stage grants an extra life.

not_in_gold_note: Present as route notes in the prior but the page is not yet pinned in the scan. They must NOT be scored as misses against the Japanese parse; they are open extraction tasks.
